### 1. Scene
A fruit-and-salad plate: pineapple, strawberries and blueberries alongside leafy greens with cucumber and shredded carrot.

### 2. Vessel
A shallow white plate, approximately **26 cm** across.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

### 3. Items
Visible foods are pineapple chunks, strawberries, blueberries, leafy greens, cucumber pieces and carrot shreds. The salad appears lightly glossy, so I include a small amount of dressing; its composition is uncertain.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight and energy
Area shares below represent non-overlapping portions of the plate. Bulk density is the only adjustment for gaps.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Strawberries | 13% | 69 × 2.5 = 173 ml | 0.60 | 103 g | 32 | 33 |
| Blueberries | 4% | 21 × 1.4 = 30 ml | 0.65 | 19 g | 57 | 11 |
| Pineapple | 9% | 48 × 2.4 = 115 ml | 0.65 | 74 g | 50 | 37 |
| Leafy greens | 20% | 106 × 2.0 = 212 ml | 0.15 | 32 g | 20 | 6 |
| Cucumber | 4% | 21 × 1.2 = 25 ml | 0.65 | 17 g | 15 | 3 |
| Shredded carrot | 2% | 11 × 0.8 = 9 ml | 0.55 | 5 g | 41 | 2 |
| Light dressing coating | Overlaps salad | Approximately 100 × 0.05 = 5 ml | 1.0 | 5 g | 400 | 20 |

**Coverage check:** 13 + 4 + 9 + 20 + 4 + 2 = **52%**, consistent with the substantial empty rim and exposed plate. Dressing adds no separate footprint.

### 8. Sanity check
Estimated total: **255 g and 112 kcal**. This is plausible for a loosely piled salad and several substantial fruit pieces. Dressing quantity and composition are the largest energy uncertainties.
